newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 2.03 million barrels in the week ended Nov 22 to 300.28 million barrels from 302.31 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 7.76 million barrels in the week to 234.69 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 660,000 barrels to 118.22 million from 117.56 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.72 million barrels to 45.16 million barrels.
API said gasoline stocks fell 637,000 barrels in the week to 186.70 million barrels from 187.34 million barrels. Percent of capacity rose to 93.7 percent from 92.9 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 953,000 barrels to 38.34 million barrels from 37.38 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.31 million barrels from 14.16 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 38.58 million barrels from 38.87 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports rose to 6.94 million barrels per day from 6.92 million, API said.
